g.text: DATA ARCHITECTURE BREAKDOWN
Under-the-hood engine internals, storage formats, compute virtualization, and architectural trade-offs.
Databricks
THE CODE-FIRST LAKEHOUSE
Execution Engine: Photon (C++)
• Apache Spark + Vectorized Photon engine in C++
• JVM memory bypass via native SIMD instructions
• Extreme throughput Spark Structured Streaming
Storage: Delta Lake (UniForm)
• Parquet + JSON ACID transaction log (_delta_log)
• UniForm generates Iceberg & Hudi metadata in-place
• True open files in customer storage (S3/ADLS/GCS)
Governance: Unity Catalog
• 3-level namespace: catalog.schema.table
• Unified multi-cloud governance (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Governs tables, models, features, functions & agents
AI & Workflows: Mosaic AI
• Native MLflow tracking + Vector Search + Model Serving
• Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for Git CI/CD
• Full LLM fine-tuning, RAG ops & Compound AI systems
ARCHITECTURAL SWEET SPOT & TRADEOFF
Best when: You write PySpark, Scala, or Python.
Unmatched for complex ETL pipelines, massive streaming data,
model training, and cross-cloud open-lake architectures.
Trade-off: Cluster spin-up latency & DBU cost tuning.
Snowflake
THE SQL-FIRST WAREHOUSE
Compute: Virtual Warehouses
• Multi-cluster shared data (MCSD) architecture
• Zero cluster config: T-shirt sizing (XS to 6XL)
• Sub-second auto-resume & auto-suspend by query
Storage: Micro-Partitions + Iceberg
• Proprietary columnar micro-partitions (50–500MB)
• Automatic clustering & min/max pruning (zero index ops)
• Apache Iceberg tables backed by customer external storage
Governance: Snowflake Horizon
• Zero-copy cloning for instant dev/QA testing
• Secure Data Sharing across clouds with zero ETL copying
• Dynamic data masking, tag policies & row-level security
AI & Apps: Snowpark & Cortex
• Cortex LLMs callable directly inside SQL statements
• Snowpark pushes Python DataFrames into warehouse nodes
• Native App Framework + embedded Streamlit UIs
ARCHITECTURAL SWEET SPOT & TRADEOFF
Best when: You want pure SQL & zero infra ops.
The gold standard for analytical SQL, fast dbt execution,
unlimited read concurrency, and data monetization.
Trade-off: Fast credit consumption if warehouse auto-suspend lags.
Microsoft Fabric
THE ALL-IN-ONE ECOSYSTEM
Compute: Shared Multi-Engine
• F-SKU capacity pool shared across all engines
• Apache Spark, T-SQL Warehouse, KQL & Data Factory
• 24-hour background smoothing absorbs bursty workloads
Storage: OneLake (SaaS Delta)
• Single logical SaaS data lake built on Delta Parquet
• OneLake Shortcuts virtualize ADLS, S3, & Snowflake
• Direct Lake mode: Power BI queries Delta with zero refresh
Governance: OneLake & Purview
• Domain & Workspace Data Mesh boundary isolation
• OneLake Security: Unified RBAC across all query engines
• Native automated Microsoft Purview catalog & lineage
AI & BI Integration: Copilot
• Built-in Copilot across Notebooks, SQL, and Power BI
• Native Git Integration (ADO & GitHub) with PBIR / NB sync
• Unrivaled seamless delivery to Microsoft 365 & Teams
ARCHITECTURAL SWEET SPOT & TRADEOFF
Best when: Your enterprise runs on Power BI & Azure.
The all-in-one SaaS platform: pipelines, Spark, warehouse,
and Power BI under one tenant with Direct Lake speed.
Trade-off: Fixed capacity sizing & ecosystem still maturing.
THE KEY
TAKEAWAY
The Real Architectural Trade-Off: Engine Control vs. Concurrency Simplicity vs. All-in-One SaaS
Databricks
Maximum compute control & deep open-source tuning.
Ideal for large engineering teams writing PySpark & training ML models.
Snowflake
Zero infra operations & unmatched SQL concurrency.
Ideal for analytics warehouses, fast dbt models, and cross-cloud sharing.
Microsoft Fabric
Unified SaaS ecosystem with zero-copy OneLake shortcuts.
Ideal for enterprises building reports in Power BI and living inside Azure.
